acceptance: Measure the delta in a real benchbox CLI command that translates SQL, on macOS and Linux.
Decide whether lazy import, pre-warming or another approach removes it without unpacking source; record the decision.
If a regression budget applies to CLI startup, confirm it is met.
description: Measured on macOS arm64: a fresh interpreter importing SQLGlot and translating 'SELECT 1' took a median 373 ms from the bundled zip versus 70 ms from an unpacked, bytecode-cached install. The cost was accepted for the first release but never optimized or measured in CLI startup or short-lived runs.
